Being a \(1\)-dimensional continuous complex, \(V_{\{1\}}\) contains uncountably many points. The points of \(V_{\{1\}}\) are precisely the rank \(1\) elements of \(\Dr(F_7)\) contained in \(V_{\{1\}}\), and a \(1\)-dimensional metric tree has continuum many such points. Thus
\[
|I(V_{\{1\}})|=\mathfrak c.
\]
